name: AhiPoki
notes: Restaurant's own site (ahiipoke.com, /poké-cart page) is a Duda build-your-own poke menu with EVERY menuItemPrice field blank (Regular/Large bowl base prices not published) — only modifier add-on prices ($1.50 avocado, $1.00 egg, $0.75 sauce) appear in item descriptions, not as dish prices. Used DoorDash marketplace schema.org Menu JSON-LD instead (server-rendered, address confirmed matches Rosecrans St). Markup test: prices are POS-style odd-cent ($x.95/.99/.75/.25) with no consistent divisor across items — passes. Grubhub and Uber Eats pages for this location returned no price data in raw HTML (JS shells) so no second priced source was reachable for cross-check. Categories reached: Poke Bowls, Grilled Bowls, Sides (incl. Musubi & Miso Soup), Sushi Rolls, Beverages. Restaurant's own site additionally lists Soup, Desserts, and general Sushi categories not present in the DoorDash listing (delivery listing may not carry the full section set) — those are unpriced everywhere reachable and are omitted rather than guessed.

Used DoorDash marketplace schema.org Menu JSON-LD instead (server-rendered; address confirmed '555 Broadway' matches work list). Markup test: prices are ordinary POS $X.99 tiers (8.99/9.99/10.99/12.99/14.99/15.99 etc.) with no clean uniform divisor -- passes. Grubhub's rendered page for this restaurant is a pure JS shell with no server data (13.6KB, no prices). Categories reached: Appetizers, Soup and Salad, Mo:Mo, Vegetarian Curry, Chicken Curry, Lamb Curry, Sea Food Curry, Biryani Items, Tandoori's, Naan Breads. A search summary for this restaurant additionally names Desserts, Side Orders, Beverages, and Chef Special sections that are NOT present in this DoorDash listing (delivery listings carry only the sections a restaurant chose for that marketplace) -- those remain unpriced/unreached here.
